title: Benowitz's drawings of an alien craft flown by the US government

tellings.quote: he said it was a a craft that the aliens had gave given to the United States government and the government was flying it and they didn't know how to do it and it crashed.

plain: In the early 1980s near Archuleta Mesa in New Mexico, a businessman named Paul Bennewitz made drawings of what he said was a craft the aliens had given to the US government, which the government flew without really knowing how, until it crashed. The researcher and writer Greg Bishop tells this, summing up what Bennewitz said and pointing to the material known as Project Beta. If true, it would mean the government was flying an alien craft.
